text: DEFONEOS — CO Cabinet Office — National Resilience & Civil Contingencies AI Deep-Dive Pack ⚠ EU AI Act Article 50 — Transparency & Compliance: This pack maps sovereign AI governance obligations for CO Cabinet Office national resilience, COBR crisis management, and civil contingencies. High-risk classification under Annex III. Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × CO × Cabinet Office × National Resilience × COBR CO Cabinet Office — National Resilience & Civil Contingencies AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance framework for the Cabinet Office — covering national crisis management, civil contingencies, cyber defence, digital government, and intergovernmental coordination across 12 mission-critical entry points. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 12 Entry Points Resilience 1. COBR & Crisis Management Cabinet Office Briefing Room (COBR) coordination, national crisis response, cross-government resilience. Civil Contingencies Secretariat, National Security Council integration, and emergency coordination centre operations across all UK regions. Planning 2. National Risk Assessment National Risk Register (NRR) maintenance, risk assessment methodology, community risk register alignment. Pandemic preparedness, flooding, cyber attack, CBRN, and cascading failure scenario modelling with annual refresh cycle. Strategy 3. National Security Strategy National Security Strategy refresh, Integrated Review, strategic threat assessment. NSS Council, threat prioritisation, and resource allocation across the 5 national security objectives. Coordination 4. Civil Contingencies Act CCA 2004 Category 1 & 2 responder coordination, Local Resilience Forums (LRFs), emergency planning duty. 43 LRFs across England, multi-agency coordination, and Gold/Silver/Bronze command structure. Cyber 5. National Cyber Security NCSC operational management, Active Cyber Defence, Cyber Essentials scheme. National Cyber Strategy, critical national infrastructure (CNI) protection, and cyber incident response coordination. Government 6. Government Digital Service GOV.UK platform, GOV.UK Pay/Notify/SignIn, digital service standard. Government as a Platform, open standards, and cross-department digital transformation. Data 7. National Data Strategy National Data Strategy implementation, data.gov.uk, Government Statistical Service. Data quality frameworks, data sharing agreements, and analytical capability building across departments. Integrity 8. Propriety & Ethics Ministerial code enforcement, special advisers code, business appointment rules. Propriety and Ethics team, conflict of interest management, and government transparency. Devolution 9. Devolution & Intergovernmental Relations Intergovernmental Relations Review, Joint Ministerial Committee, interministerial group coordination. Sewel Convention monitoring, legislative consent motion tracking, and devolution settlement management. Honours 10. Honours & Public Appointments Honours nomination processing, committee assessment, investiture coordination. Public appointments process, Commissioner for Public Appointments oversight, and vetting for honours. Civil Service 11. Civil Service Reform Civil Service Reform Plan, capability building, talent management. Fast Stream recruitment, SCS performance management, and cross-government people strategy. Accountability 12. Parliamentary Accountability Cabinet Office Select Committee, PACAC oversight, parliamentary questions. Ministerial accountability, government transparency, and FOI coordination across departments. 8 Transformation Priorities Priority 1 COBR Digital Crisis Room Crisis coordination latency 6h→30min, cross-government situational awareness +80%. AI-assisted COBR briefings, real-time data fusion from departmental feeds, and automated situation report generation. Target: national crisis response activation within 15 minutes. Priority 2 National Risk AI Engine Risk register refresh cycle 12mo→continuous, emerging threat det
